corrections.evidence: The Premier League tactical article dated 26 October 2018 explicitly describes Martial as a winger/wide attacker and records 351 minutes of Premier League action and his brace at Chelsea. This establishes position and competitive top-flight appearances inside 2010-11 to 2025-26. Manchester United official reports corroborate his left-wing role. Fame 4 follows the established middle scale for recognised PL wingers; no existing fame changed.

Manchester United official 16 August 2020 loan announcement identifies Chong as a first-team winger. The Premier League 14 July 2023 announcement explicitly records his competitive PL debut in the 2019 3-2 Southampton match. Both precede the fixed 2025-26 cutoff. Fame 3 preserves the level already used for Chong elsewhere in the existing bank.

Rayo Vallecano official 26 September 2018 report records Advíncula scoring for the first team against Real Sociedad in LaLiga Santander, establishing a competitive top-flight appearance inside 2005-06 to 2025-26. Peru official news agency Andina 3 May 2021 record identifies him as Rayo right-back and documents 28 Primera appearances. This supplies position evidence separately from the league appearance. Fame 2 follows existing right-backs such as Hamari Traoré.

The corrections resolve prior pending submissions; none of the current newly fetched events require these additions. Explicit outside-UK scope exclusions were also discarded.
